verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 docs show NVIDIA's software stack running on the part: nvidia-smi reports per-GPU power and the system ships Docker Engine with the NVIDIA Container Toolkit. They also position it for training and inference workloads, and a community user reports running on B200 on demand. None of this cites CUDA documentation naming B200 as a supported compute target, so it only implies toolchain support. Missing for 10: explicit CUDA toolkit/compute-capability documentation listing B200, a CUDA version support matrix, and hands-on reports of compiling and running CUDA code on B200.
